name: Open Close Store for WooCommerce – Business Hours & Order Scheduling
author: Capiri, Ltd.

sections.description:
Accept online orders only when your team is ready to fulfill them.

Open Close Store for WooCommerce lets you set daily ordering hours and multiple service shifts. Outside those hours, the free plugin can stop checkout, hide add-to-cart controls, show a closed-store message and count down to reopening.

It is especially useful for restaurants, takeout shops, bakeries and other WooCommerce businesses with time-sensitive fulfillment.

New ownership, active development

Open Close Store is now maintained by Capiri Ltd. Recent updates improve closing-time accuracy, clarify closed-store messages, and introduce an illustrated setup guide. We’re continuing to improve reliability and support.

Scheduled checkout blocking is included in the free version. Have a question or an unresolved issue? Contact hello@openclosestore.com.

⭐ Compare Free and Pro & view pricing | Pro checkout | 🛟 Get support

Need to accept orders outside normal service hours? Pro adds after-hours preorders, instant open/close overrides and per-product rules, plus frontend schedule management and Dokan vendor schedules.

Watch the Free setup walkthrough

Watch the 98-second setup video: set weekly opening hours, enable closed-hours checkout protection, add holiday closures and test your schedule. Includes optional captions and a transcript. The walkthrough uses a fictional demo store and simulated interactions with the actual Free interface.

Follow the illustrated setup guide or try the free plugin in a disposable demo.

🚀 Free Features

  • Schedule management (daily time slots)
  • Active schedule selection and week start day
  • Full-day holiday closures on selected dates in your store time zone
  • Setup and status page showing schedule, checkout protection and next opening
  • Disable checkout when the store is closed
  • Hide add to cart when closed (with optional popup-on-click mode)
  • Countdown timers on cart, checkout, product, and account pages
  • Store status bar and closed-store popup
  • Business hours display shortcodes and widget
  • Admin bar shop status shortcut
  • WooCommerce HPOS and cart/checkout blocks compatibility declarations

⭐ PRO Features (separate plugin)

  • After-Hours Preorders – Accept preorders for all or selected products while ordinary ordering is closed
  • Instant Open/Close Override – Change store status immediately and show a custom message
  • Per-Product Rules – Allow or block selected products based on store status
  • Cart Controls – Empty the cart automatically or keep permitted products available
  • Frontend Schedule Manager – Manage schedules without entering the WordPress admin area
  • Dokan Vendor Schedules – Apply vendor-specific schedules in Dokan marketplaces
  • 24-Hour Days – Keep the store open continuously on selected days
  • Status Bar Styling – Customize the status bar and hide-button colors

⚙️ Shortcodes

Display Single Schedule

[schedule id="71"]

Display a specific schedule anywhere on your site. Replace “71” with your actual schedule ID.

Countdown Timer

[woc_countdown_timer]  and [woc_countdown_timer style="1"] for style 1,2,3

Show a countdown timer until the store reopens. Customize the appearance in the plugin settings.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Check Settings > General > Timezone, then go to Schedules > Add Schedule. Enter a title, closed-store message, and opening/closing time slots for each day. Publish the schedule.
  4. Go to Schedules > Setup & holidays. Choose your Active weekly schedule, select Block checkout when the store is scheduled closed if needed, and click Save schedule & protection. Review the store time zone and status shown above. Existing detailed options remain under Schedules > Settings.
  5. Optionally display your hours using the shortcode shown beside your schedule. Use your own schedule ID.
  6. Test open and closed periods on a staging store as a logged-out shopper, including your actual cart, checkout and payment extensions. Follow the illustrated setup and troubleshooting guide.
sections.faq:
How does the store scheduling work?

Set the days and times when your store accepts orders. During closed hours, the free plugin can disable checkout, hide add-to-cart controls and show a notice. Pro can accept preorders while ordinary ordering is closed.

Will this plugin work with my timezone?

Yes! The plugin automatically uses your WordPress timezone settings. You can find these settings at Settings > General > Timezone in your WordPress admin panel.

Can I close for holidays without changing weekly hours?

Yes. Go to Schedules > Setup & holidays, add the closed dates and save. Each date closes ordinary ordering for that full date in the store time zone. Your weekly schedule stays unchanged. Enable checkout protection on the same page if you want to stop orders while closed. Remove or clear a date and save to return that date to your usual weekly schedule. Pro’s existing preorder rules and manual overrides still apply; holidays do not add pickup or delivery reservations.

Does it work with WordPress Multisite?

Verify the intended multisite configuration on staging with the versions and extensions in use. Individual sites may have different settings.

Is it compatible with my theme?

Compatibility depends on your theme and checkout extensions. Test the actual store setup on staging and contact hello@openclosestore.com with relevant versions and observed behavior if you need help.

Can I set different hours for different days?

Yes! You can set unique schedules for each day of the week, with multiple time slots per day if needed.

Is this plugin available in my language?

The plugin is translation ready. You can contribute translations at WordPress Translate.
